subject: Taxes
title: The Intellectual Property Trick
description: A fast breakdown of The Intellectual Property Trick for builders.

hook.text: Google moved its search algorithm to Bermuda. Now the entity owning the code earns the profits—taxed at 0% in Bermuda.

discovery.text: The subsidiary then charges royalties to every other office worldwide.

twist.text: Ireland created the 'Knowledge Development Box' taxing IP income at 6.25%.

climax.text: IP migration is the most powerful corporate tax strategy because ideas have no physical location.

punchline.text: Move the patent, move the profit. IP has no natural home.

quiz.question: Why is intellectual property easy to shift to tax havens?
options: It has no physical location and can be legally transferred anywhere
